```{ojs}
//| output: false
mapResize = {
  const el = mapEl;
  const map = el._map;
  const body = el.closest(".card-body") || el.parentElement;
  let fitted = false;
  const apply = () => {
    const height = Math.max(300, Math.floor(body.clientHeight));
    if (Math.abs(el.clientHeight - height) > 1) el.style.height = height + "px";
    map.invalidateSize();
    if (!fitted && el.clientWidth > 0 && el.clientHeight > 0) {
      fitted = true;
      const bounds = countryBounds.get("__all__");
      if (bounds) map.fitBounds(bounds, {padding: [24, 24], maxZoom: 6});
    }
  };
  const observer = new ResizeObserver(apply);
  observer.observe(body);
  apply();
  invalidation.then(() => observer.disconnect());
  return true;
}
mapTiles = {
  const el = mapEl;
  const map = el._map;
  const basemap = meta.basemap;
  const options = {
    attribution: basemap.attribution,
    maxZoom: basemap.max_zoom,
    crossOrigin: true
  };
  if (basemap.subdomains) options.subdomains = basemap.subdomains;
  const layer = L.tileLayer(theme === "dark" ? basemap.dark_url : basemap.light_url, options);
  layer.addTo(map);
  if (el._tiles) map.removeLayer(el._tiles);
  el._tiles = layer;
  el.classList.toggle("cgp-tiles-invert", Boolean(basemap.dark_filter) && theme === "dark");
  return theme;
}
effectiveColorMode = currency === "Local" && colorMode === "absolute" ? "rank" : colorMode

// Absolute mode needs USD; disable it when showing local currency.
absoluteGuard = {
  const input = (viewof colorMode).querySelector('input[data-value="absolute"]');
  const disabled = currency === "Local";
  if (input) {
    input.disabled = disabled;
    const label = input.closest("label");
    if (label) label.title = disabled ? "Absolute needs USD" : "";
  }
  return disabled;
}
absoluteDomain = {
  if (effectiveColorMode !== "absolute") return null;
  const values = [];
  for (const station of latest) {
    const value = stationPrice(station, grade, "USD", volume);
    if (value != null) values.push(value);
  }
  if (values.length < 2) return null;
  values.sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const lo = quantileSorted(values, 0.02);
  const hi = quantileSorted(values, 0.98);
  return hi > lo ? [lo, hi] : null;
}
rankPercentiles = {
  if (effectiveColorMode !== "rank") return new Map();
  const byCountry = new Map();
  for (const station of latest) {
    const value = stationPrice(station, grade, currency, volume);
    if (value == null) continue;
    if (!byCountry.has(station.country)) byCountry.set(station.country, []);
    byCountry.get(station.country).push({key: station.station_key, value});
  }
  const out = new Map();
  for (const [, rows] of byCountry) {
    rows.sort((a, b) => a.value - b.value);
    const n = rows.length;
    let i = 0;
    while (i < n) {
      let j = i;
      while (j + 1 < n && rows[j + 1].value === rows[i].value) j += 1;
      const averageRank = (i + j) / 2 + 1; // 1-based; ties share the average
      const pct = n === 1 ? 0.5 : (averageRank - 1) / (n - 1);
      for (let k = i; k <= j; k += 1) out.set(rows[k].key, pct);
      i = j + 1;
    }
  }
  return out;
}
markerLayerUpdate = {
  const el = mapEl;
  const layer = el._markers;
  const pal = palette;
  const domain = absoluteDomain;
  const ranks = rankPercentiles;
  // Updated here so clusterIcon sees the current palette.
  el._pal = pal;
  layer.clearLayers();
  let count = 0;
  for (const station of latest) {
    if (station.lat == null || station.lon == null) continue;
    if (!gradeEntry(station, grade)) continue;
    const value = stationPrice(station, grade, currency, volume);
    let fill = pal.missing;
    if (value != null && effectiveColorMode === "rank") {
      fill = colorForFraction(ranks.get(station.station_key), pal);
    } else if (value != null && domain) {
      const usd = stationPrice(station, grade, "USD", volume);
      const t =
        usd == null ? null : Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (usd - domain[0]) / (domain[1] - domain[0])));
      fill = colorForFraction(t, pal);
    }
    const fraction =
      effectiveColorMode === "rank"
        ? ranks.get(station.station_key)
        : usdFraction(station, grade, volume, domain);
    const marker = L.circleMarker([station.lat, station.lon], {
      radius: markerRadius(el._map.getZoom(), fraction),
      weight: 1,
      color: pal.stroke,
      opacity: 0.9,
      fillColor: fill,
      fillOpacity: 0.85
    });
    marker._cgpFraction = fraction;
    marker.bindPopup(() => popupHtml(station, volume), {maxWidth: 340, autoPan: true});
    // Lazy: built on hover, not once per marker per rebuild.
    marker.bindTooltip(() => hoverHtml(station), {
      direction: "top",
      offset: [0, -4],
      className: "cgp-hover-tip"
    });
    marker.addTo(layer);
    count += 1;
  }
  el.setAttribute("data-marker-count", String(count));
  applyZoomStyling(el);
  return count;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
mapLegend = {
  const pal = palette;
  const caption =
    effectiveColorMode === "rank"
      ? "least to most expensive within each country"
      : `USD ${volumeLabel}, 2nd to 98th percentile`;
  return html`<div class="cgp-legend"><span class="cgp-legend-end">Lower price</span>${pal.ramp.map(
    (color) => html`<span class="cgp-swatch" style=${"background:" + color}></span>`
  )}<span class="cgp-legend-end">Higher price</span>
    <span class="cgp-legend-note">${caption}</span>
    <span class="cgp-legend-missing"><span class="cgp-swatch" style=${
      "background:" + pal.missing
    }></span> no USD value</span></div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
countryPills = {
  const el = mapEl;
  const buttons = ["World", ...COUNTRY_ORDER].map((code) => {
    const button = html`<button type="button" data-zoom=${code}>${
      code === "World" ? "🌐" : countryFlag(code)
    } ${code === "World" ? "World" : COUNTRY_NAMES[code]}</button>`;
    button.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const bounds = countryBounds.get(code === "World" ? "__all__" : code);
      if (bounds) el._map.fitBounds(bounds, {padding: [24, 24], maxZoom: 11});
    });
    return button;
  });
  return html`<div class="cgp-pills">${buttons}</div>`;
}
```

::: {.cgp-panel}

```{ojs}
// Defined in the card that shows it (OJS nodes live where they're defined).
mapEl = {
  const el = html`<div class="cgp-map" data-marker-count="0" style="height:360px"></div>`;
  // maxZoom set before the tile layer: the cluster group needs a bounded zoom.
  const map = L.map(el, {
    zoomControl: true,
    worldCopyJump: true,
    preferCanvas: true,
    maxZoom: 19
  });
  map.setView([25, -30], 2);
  el._map = map;
  // Stations cluster at continent scale and ungroup past LABEL_ZOOM.
  el._markers = (
    clusterL.markerClusterGroup
      ? clusterL.markerClusterGroup({
          maxClusterRadius: 44,
          disableClusteringAtZoom: LABEL_ZOOM,
          spiderfyOnMaxZoom: false,
          showCoverageOnHover: false,
          chunkedLoading: true,
          iconCreateFunction: (cluster) => clusterIcon(el, cluster)
        })
      : L.layerGroup()
  ).addTo(map);
  map.on("zoomend", () => applyZoomStyling(el));
  map.on("popupopen", (event) => {
    const node = event.popup.getElement();
    const link = node ? node.querySelector("[data-station-link]") : null;
    if (!link) return;
    link.addEventListener("click", (clickEvent) => {
      clickEvent.preventDefault();
      stationChannel.open(link.getAttribute("data-station-link"));
    });
  });
  invalidation.then(() => map.remove());
  return el;
}
```
